cap: Estrogen lowers osteoblast RANKL and raises osteoprotegerin, the decoy receptor, so osteoclasts are restrained; after menopause increased RANKL signaling and less osteoprotegerin remove trabecular bone first, and denosumab blocks RANKL. In the Women's Health Initiative, estrogen plus medroxyprogesterone cut hip fractures and colorectal cancer but raised invasive breast cancer, stroke, venous thromboembolism and coronary events, so it is not first-line for bone alone.
